description_en: Retrieves the namespaced services for a migration task
description_zh: 获取迁移的命名空间服务
name: GetMigrationNamespacedServices

parameters.help_en: The migration task ID. This parameter is a URL path parameter. Although the required field is set to false in the document metadata, you must provide a valid migration task ID when calling this operation. You can call ListMigrationTasks to obtain the migration task ID
parameters.help_zh: 迁移任务 ID。本参数为 URL 路径参数，虽然文档元数据中 required 为 false，但调用时必须提供有效的迁移任务 ID，可通过 ListMigrationTasks 查询获取
parameters.name: task_id

namespacedServices.description_en: The list of services grouped by namespace
namespacedServices.description_zh: 命名空间分组的服务列表

items.description_en: The list of services grouped by namespace
items.description_zh: 命名空间分组的服务列表

services.description_en: The list of migratable services in the namespace
services.description_zh: 该命名空间下可迁移的 Service 列表

items.description_en: The list of migratable services in the namespace
items.description_zh: 该命名空间下可迁移的 Service 列表

name.description_en: The service name. After you select a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance, the frontend populates this value into the serviceName field
name.description_zh: Service 名称（选中 SLB 后前端会把它填入 serviceName）

slbId.description_en: The ID of the load balancing instance associated with the service
slbId.description_zh: Service 关联的负载均衡实例 ID

v1_parameters.help_en: The migration task ID. This parameter is a URL path parameter. Although the required field is set to false in the document metadata, you must provide a valid migration task ID when calling this operation. You can call ListMigrationTasks to obtain the migration task ID
v1_parameters.help_zh: 迁移任务 ID。本参数为 URL 路径参数，虽然文档元数据中 required 为 false，但调用时必须提供有效的迁移任务 ID，可通过 ListMigrationTasks 查询获取
v1_parameters.name: taskId
